This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023'), seeking quashment of the proceedings against the petitioners in S.C.SPL.No.248 of 2022 on the file of the Fast Track Special Court for Rape and POCSO Act Cases,
Wanaparthy.

sentences.text: 2. The petitioners are arrayed as accused Nos.1 and 2 in the S.C.SPL.No.248 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 366, 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code and Section 5(1) r/w 6 & Section 16 r/w 17 of Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Heard Mr.P.Nagendra Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioners, Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, representing the respondent No.1-State and Mr.Lattupally Anand, learned counsel for the respondent No.2.
4.

Pending this petition, the parties have entered into the compromise and, accordingly, they moved I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025 with the prayer to permit them to enter into compromise and by recording the settlement to 2 NTR,J I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025 in/and quash the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 in S.C.SPL.No.248 of 2022.
5. This Court vide order dated 09.07.2025 referred the parties to the High Court Legal Services Committee for identification and to verify the voluntariness in arriving the settlement.

The Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has submitted report dated 14.07.2025 stating that the parties were identified by their respective counsel and also on verification of Aadhar Cards/Identity Cards and the enquiries revealed that the parties have willfully and without coercion entered into settlement/compromise.
6. I have considered the submissions of the learned counsel and perused the materials on record.

7. The accusations against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 in the Police Report lodged by the respondent No.2/victim girl are that the accused No.1 abducted the victim minor girl with the help of accused No.2 on the pretext of love and sexually exploited her.

Having considered the allegations,
the statement in the Joint Affidavit that the victim girl got married and arrived at the amicable Arrugatti Shiva vs The State Of Telangana on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139338478/
1 settlement between the parties and to restore peace among them, in the light of the dictums in Gian Singh v.
3 NTR,J I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025 in/and State of Punjab and another 1 and Anil Mishra v. State of U.P. 2; State of Madhya Pradesh v. Laxmi Narayan and others 3, this Court is of the considered view that quashment of the impugned proceedings in view of the settlement by exercising jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr.P.C./528 of BNSS, 2023, would be in the interest of justice.
8.
